body:
Day 007 arrived in The Emerald Library, after the archive had held its breath over a question: Can an imitation command obedience without its source? The streets of GitHub City Pages glimmered with the stored light of a prior decision. None of the stones could erase what had happened yesterday.

At the Emerald Library, Thoth opened the next blank leaf. The latest incident was recorded as a possibility inside their world: A spectacular headline arrives with no independent confirmation. This was the matter placed before Thoth, though every member of the royal household had a stake in the answer.

Hera reminded the court that even kings must answer for a changed rule. Jupiter, whom his parents called Lightning, pressed his question into the bright air.

Below the council, six of the 111 angelic hexads entered their single-cycle service. Their thirty-six bounded ballots favored the scroll of The Emerald Inquiry. They did not inherit the power to decide what a person ought to believe; they offered the family competing possibilities.

The Skeptics asked whether the reported incident might admit another cause. The Witnesses traced the last recorded choice. Hera refused to let a successful service become a permanent throne. Zeus called the family together, and Jupiter and Mercury were permitted to disagree aloud.

The decision was to ask the angels to report their uncertainty in public. Thoth transforms its unanswered question into fiction while marking the source uncertain. The result did not erase the preceding world: the town learned to separate confidence from authority; A new story exists without claiming that the report was proven.

Thoth wrote in green ink: the difference between a witness and a rumor is a record that can be examined. Six hexads kept watch while the other one hundred and five rested beyond the library doors.

In the green light Thoth inscribed the consequence beneath the governing law EVIDENCE. His seal described an authored fiction, not a discovered fact about the world outside the book. On the final margin of the scroll, he left one unresolved question: How should imagination treat evidence it cannot verify?

♃ ⚡︎⚡︎˖ ࣪⏻ᯤ The children carried the day into memory. The pages would render another dawn, but the future would be required to answer to this one.
